notes: Faster: going back to Home is about 5 times quicker. New in Customize > About HomeZ: Close apps unused for 2 hours (on by default; music and anything playing keep going), so the next app has more memory. After a long standby HomeZ asks the TV to recheck its network straight away, so apps don't stall. Optimize can also switch off Google's speech voice, smart-home panel and screen saver. Optimize opens at the top of its list and its buttons are no longer cut off.
